edition_title: Keen Africa Opportunities Digest — August 2026 Edition
edition_intro: You are not waiting for permission — you are building the future of a continent. This edition compiles 13 live, verified opportunities across scholarships, grants, conferences, competitions, and certifications, handpicked for ambitious young Nigerians ready to move. Study in the UK, win ₦200 million in prizes, land IFC grant funding, get certified for free, and stand on the stage where Africa's tech agenda is set. The window is open. Apply now.

posts.title: Chevening Scholarships 2027/28 (UK Government)
posts.summary: The UK Government's flagship fully funded scholarship for emerging leaders to pursue a one-year Master's degree at any eligible UK university — and Nigeria is one of its largest recipient countries.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian citizens with at least 2 years of work experience, a bachelor's degree, and demonstrable leadership potential; no upper age limit.

posts.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027 (UK — Master's)
posts.summary: Fully funded UK Master's scholarships for talented candidates from lower-income Commonwealth countries, including Nigeria, studying development-focused disciplines.
posts.deadline: Rolling — check country page; typically October–November 2026
posts.eligibility: Nigerian nationals who are permanent residents in Nigeria, hold a first degree (minimum upper second-class), and are unable to afford UK university fees without support.

posts.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (Multiple African Universities)
posts.summary: Fully funded undergraduate and graduate scholarships at top African and global partner universities, designed specifically for academically talented but economically disadvantaged young Africans.
posts.deadline: Rolling — varies by partner university; several windows open August–September 2026
posts.eligibility: Young Africans (typically 35 and under) with demonstrated academic excellence and financial need; specific criteria vary by partner institution.

posts.title: IFC SME Growth Accelerator Grant 2026 (World Bank Group)
posts.summary: The World Bank Group's IFC is offering USD $50,000–$1.5 million in non-dilutive grant funding to high-potential SMEs in Africa with proven revenue and strong growth ambitions.
posts.eligibility: For-profit SMEs operating in Africa with 10–250 employees and verified annual revenues of USD $250,000–$10 million, with a scalable business model.

posts.title: Accelerate Africa Startup Programme 2026 (Future Africa Fund)
posts.summary: An equity-free accelerator connecting early-stage African founders to expert mentorship, structured support, and potential investment of up to USD $500,000 from the Future Africa fund.
posts.eligibility: Early-stage startup founders across Africa building high-growth, globally ambitious, technology-driven ventures; no application fee.

posts.title: UNDP Timbuktoo Pan-African MineTech Startup Incubation Programme 2026
posts.summary: UNDP's Timbuktoo initiative is selecting African MineTech (mining technology) startups for a pan-continental incubation programme with funding, technical mentorship, and market access.
posts.deadline: Rolling — check portal; applications open now
posts.eligibility: African startups developing technology-driven solutions for the mining and mineral resources sector; open to founders from all 54 African countries.

posts.title: Moonshot by TechCabal 2026 — Lagos, Nigeria
posts.summary: Africa's fastest-growing flagship technology conference returns to Lagos on October 28–29, 2026, convening thousands of founders, investors, policymakers, and operators under the theme 'Courage & Conviction.'
posts.deadline: Rolling — tickets on sale now; speaker applications open
posts.eligibility: Open to all — ticket purchase required for general attendance; speaker applications open to founders, operators, investors, researchers, and ecosystem leaders.

posts.title: Africa Deep Tech Conference 2026 (ADTF)
posts.summary: A pan-African convening connecting builders, founders, funders, and researchers accelerating frontier technology — AI, robotics, biotech, web3, and XR — across the continent.
posts.deadline: Rolling — registration open; check official site for dates
posts.eligibility: Open to innovators, founders, researchers, and professionals working in deep tech and frontier technology across Africa.

posts.title: Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 — 'Powering Possibilities' (₦200 Million Prize Pool)
posts.summary: Wema Bank's flagship open innovation programme is back for its 7th edition with a ₦200 million cumulative prize pool across three tracks — Startup Pitch, Hackathon, and Social Impact — open to African founders and innovators.
posts.deadline: Rolling — apply immediately; exact closing date to be confirmed by Wema Bank
posts.eligibility: African startups, founders, developers, UI/UX designers, and technology enthusiasts; no formal tech degree required — a credible solution and the ability to build or scale it is sufficient.

posts.title: Build with Gemini XPRIZE Hackathon 2026 ($2 Million Prize Pool)
posts.summary: Google-backed XPRIZE is offering $2 million in prizes to teams that build real, revenue-generating AI-powered businesses in 90 days using Google's Gemini AI stack — open globally including Nigeria.
posts.eligibility: Individuals above the legal age of majority in their country, or small organisations with fewer than 25 employees; open globally (check official rules for any excluded territories).

posts.title: Hack-Nation 5th Global AI Hackathon 2026 ($30,000+ in Prizes)
posts.summary: A globally recognised 24-hour AI hackathon rooted in the MIT ecosystem, inviting developers and innovators worldwide to build cutting-edge AI solutions and compete for over $30,000 in prizes.
posts.deadline: Rolling — check official registration page for cohort dates
posts.eligibility: Open globally to developers, innovators, students, and AI enthusiasts working individually or in teams; no entry fee.

posts.title: Microsoft Virtual Training Days — Free Azure, AI & Security Certification Vouchers
posts.summary: Microsoft runs free, live online training events globally throughout 2026 — attend any qualifying session and receive a free exam voucher for Azure, AI, or Microsoft 365 certifications within days.
posts.deadline: Rolling — new events added weekly throughout 2026
posts.eligibility: Open globally to anyone with a free Microsoft Learn account; no prior experience required for fundamentals-level events (AZ-900, AI-900, SC-900).

posts.title: Cisco Networking Academy — Free Self-Paced Courses with Digital Badges (Skills for All)
posts.summary: Cisco's Skills for All platform offers completely free, self-paced online courses in networking, cybersecurity, Python, AI, and IoT — no institution required, open globally including Nigeria, with digital badges upon completion.
posts.deadline: Rolling — open enrolment year-round with no deadline
posts.eligibility: Open globally to anyone; create a free Cisco Skills for All account and start immediately — no prior experience or institutional affiliation needed.
